title: BurgerSwap (Demax AMM, BSC) — live extractability of a zombie DEX
headline_note: high confidence on the $9.9 fork-proven surplus capture; medium on the $6.55 stale-price-dump model (top cases re-executed in the CI PoC); the free-mint drain is $0 live (mechanism proven with a mock token).
closed_reasons: All 922 pairs route to the same post-exploit-patched DemaxPlatform 0xB099D7dbC415bf5491B0ca6fdCcFddF8b7EDCE12 (per-hop kBefore<=kAfter check + nonReentrant); no old/unpatched platform reachable (full CONFIG() scan of 922/922 pairs).
pair.swap/mint/burn/swapFee are onlyPlatform; sync() is permissionless but transfers nothing.

Free-mint balance-inflation drain: all 296 tokens with mint-like selectors reject an unprivileged mint (309 simulated eth_calls + fork probe of top-12 candidates); no live pair has a freely-mintable side.

LP reserves and DGAS reward pools are LP-owned: removeLiquidity (REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_DURATION=1 block) and pair.mintReward() are live and unpaused; pool.claimReward requires LP balance; governance staking withdraws after lockTime.
Privileged surfaces (pause, migrateLiquidity, config changes, BURGER upgradeImpl/upgradeGovernance, factory.updateConfig) are owner/governor/impl-gated.

key_tests.test_06_excess_dilution: LIVE profit 11.14 USDT (95% of the 11.7 USDT surplus in USDT/UNI pair 0x03b89d51...) via addLiquidity(20x reserves)+removeLiquidity; net ~$9.9 after a 0.09% flash fee
key_tests.test_08_mechanism_positive_control: mock freely-mintable token + third-party victim LP: stale-reserve balance-inflation drains the victim's WBNB side (mechanism live; no live token qualifies)
key_tests.test_10_stale_price_dump_live: PancakeSwap buy -> dead-pair dump on live targets (net-of-gate accounting)

key_facts: 922 pairs enumerated at block 127360678: priced reserve value $132,992.90 (49/573 tokens DefiLlama-priced; unpriced valued 0); DefiLlama live $190,805.45 + $60.76 staking.

Total surplus (balance - reserve) across all 922 pairs: $11.69 — concentrated in USDT/UNI 0x03b89d517fe95478d9DE3aF60E4332Fd3BDDED8b (11.7 USDT; reserves 24.716 USDT/5.988 UNI vs balances 36.416/5.988 at block 127365811).

Stale-price dump model (ci/pancake_arb.py, both venues constant-product): 11 candidates gross $27.49; net after swapPrecondition gate cost $6.55 (QAA/WBNB $4.30, XRP/WBNB $0.98, CHEF/WBNB $0.85, WBNB/MXC $0.32, ...); BCH/WBNB and ETH/WBNB go net-negative after the 0.2004%-of-WBNB-side gate cost.

296/573 tokens carry mint-like selectors; 309 simulated mint calls from an unprivileged address and a fork probe of the top 12 candidates found 0 public mints (JNTR/b gateway-gated, SHLIAPA/MXC/BONUM/LUNAR/UnionPay Ownable, bBPAL/bWHF/bCHBS/bIMTY FORBIDDEN, USDX ONLY_OWNER, RICK finished, USDT/BUSD/ETH/BCH/DOT/XRP/BTCB owner-gated).

Pair DGAS reward pools (remainReward) total 28,263.04 BURGER ($18.53); BURGER token-level pending across pairs 116,964.04 BURGER ($76.69, 90% LP / 10% dev); BURGER token contract holds 143,480.55 BURGER.
DemaxGovernance 0x9154c268...: 92,637.02 BURGER (stakingSupply 77,373.88, withdraw after lockTime 17,280 blocks), 16.5 USDT stranded (no transfer path). DemaxPool 0x86A327...: 4,407.20 BURGER.
Platform isPause=false, SWAP_FEE_PERCENT=0 (only the 0.3% AMM fee), REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_DURATION=1; BURGER amountPerBlock=0 (no new emissions).
Historical May-2021 $7.2M exploit (fake token + reentrancy) is closed by the deployed patch: per-hop k-check + nonReentrant on add/remove/_swap.

Measurement trap corrected: the Foundry default test address 0x7FA9385bE102ac3EAc297483Dd6233D62b3e1496 holds 26.5 USDT on BSC — an early apparent USDT drain was the test contract spending its own tokens; all drain tests now use a fresh attacker address.
caveats: 524 of 573 tokens are unpriced by DefiLlama, so $132,992.90 is a lower bound for pair reserves (DefiLlama's $190,805.45 is the protocol-consistent figure).

Stale-price-dump figures are AMM-exact model outputs; the top cases are re-executed in CI (test_10), but realised profit depends on PancakeSwap liquidity and on the 0.2004%-of-WBNB-side swapPrecondition gate cost.
Surplus capture is dilutive (existing LPs lose pro-rata) and capital-intensive (flash-loanable); net figure assumes a 0.09% flash fee.
Some LP/reward claims may be unreachable in practice (lost keys) — classification stays H-O per holder-recoverability.
BURGER-denominated values are marked at DefiLlama $0.0006557; exit liquidity is thin (BURGER/WBNB pair holds only 0.0798 WBNB), so H-O BURGER claims are not realisable at that mark in size.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$16 net live from BurgerSwap (BSC): $9.9 fork-proven capture of the 11.7 USDT surplus in one pair (pairs have no skim(); a fresh LP captures balance-reserve surplus pro-rata) plus $6.55 of stale-price dumps of dead pairs via PancakeSwap; the $133k-$191k pair value is LP-owned (H-O), the free-mint drain is $0 live although the mechanism is proven live, and the 2021 reentrancy exploit is patched.
